layout_sources: https://ro-che.info/articles/2018-03-04-santander-export-transactions (the TXT download: Latin-1, non-breaking spaces as separators, some records carry a currency)

https://github.com/splogdes/monzo-grafana/blob/main/monzo_grafana/santander/parser.py (From:/Account: header lines, 4-line Date/Description/Amount/Balance blocks, U+00A0 after each label, single-byte encoding, newest first)
https://github.com/PurpleBooth/santander-txt-to-csv/blob/master/txt-to-csv.php (separator lines of 7 tabs after the date range and 6 tabs between blocks; ":\xA0" between key and value)
https://business.santander.co.uk/Estatico/ALP_SBBI_Templates/Html/help50000048.html (download formats: Excel, Quicken, Acrobat, Microsoft Money, TXT)
notes: Not a table: "From: <dd/mm/yyyy> to <dd/mm/yyyy>", a line of 7 tabs, "Account: XXXX XXXX XXXX 1234", then one block per line (Date, Description, Amount, Balance), each label followed by a non-breaking space (byte A0), blocks separated by a line of 6 tabs; the Amount line ends with a tab. Newest first, DD/MM/YYYY, signed Amount, Balance after each line, HTML entities left in descriptions ("MARKS&SPENCER"). Windows-1252 single-byte text; CRLF assumed (not confirmed). Some files add the currency after an amount; not shown here.
